Hello,
I would like to know whether there are any differences between the INLA program  and the R INLA interface package besides the differences in the syntax and the way the programs are run. The INLA R interface is more user friendly but I was wandering if there are any disadvantages of using it versus the INLA program itself.
Thank you,
Georgiana
